program_comparison.decision: Do not open another feature/window substitution from the heavily covered technical/ML families. A new entry mechanism must supply information beyond those closed neighborhoods.

Select prospective delayed repo-pressure conditioning of newly observed intraday shocks. The just-closed source study creates attributable input readiness, not an economic seed. Its ordinary headline, prior-20 median, eight-calendar-day delay and as-published method chronology remain fixed.
Do not reopen opening/fix families or use intraday external-time repairs; the proposed source is deliberately delayed and does not rely on exact external-local session alignment.
Family 011 has no retained exit seed. Do not carry its favorable 2024 trailing fragment or alter its hash/risk/hold after loss.
No independent alpha supports weights, deposit or leverage repair. Keep the established prospective risk scale separate from source efficacy.
Two bounded source/clock questions are now closed. Do not create a reusable diagnostic framework or prolong source auditing without a specific new issue.

prospective_question.hypothesis: Abnormally high delayed Treasury-repo funding basis may condition propagation versus compensation of fresh negative index-price shocks; a low basis supplies the symmetric positive-shock case. Compare the two causal response directions once as one bundle. This is a hypothesis, not established predictability.
prospective_question.new_information_required_per_entry: A newly completed M30 body shock at least one prior ATR14 in magnitude. Above-median repo basis pairs with negative shocks and below-median basis with positive shocks. A stable daily rate alone never triggers a fresh lifecycle; no flatten/reopen churn is used to manufacture turnover.
prospective_question.prospective_geometry: Broker M30 bars, prior ATR14, 2 ATR original stop, 4 ATR take and maximum four completed M30 bars. These are pre-economic proposal terms that must enter the binding declaration before any candidate price outcome.
prospective_question.universe: FPMarkets US100, US30 and US500; no FX subset chosen from Family 011 outcomes.
prospective_question.prospective_risk: $100, target 2%, minimum-lot hard cap 3%, original-stop aggregate cap 8%; no post-result risk rescue.
prospective_question.source_lag: Only ordinary SOFR-TGCR known no earlier than effectiveDate +8 calendar days; maximum source age 30 days; strict prior-20-source median; no unofficial retrospective series.
prospective_question.expected_information: Test an independent macro funding field jointly with fresh endogenous information rather than treating repeated daily state as repeated alpha. Source variation alone cannot establish the required economic frequency.

data_readiness.metadata_only_inventory: Existing original-broker US100/US30 M1 parquets and separately captured pre-control US500 M1 arrays exist in this repository. No candidate price arrays were opened for this proposal.
data_readiness.candidate_parent_boundary: The exact V7-return family does not become a candidate parent. If an existing pre-control raw market array is used, it must be explicitly attributed only as a price observation, filtered to the declared period and physically copied into the new family input; no V7/V8 strategy, opportunities, state or outcomes may transfer.
data_readiness.locked_values: No 2026 array is opened before a justified unchanged survivor. Prior aggregate and incidental documentation exposure must be disclosed in confirmation authority.
data_readiness.source_topology: A future family owns its own Python adapter and data. No cross-root source include/link/execute. Native EA remains conditional on a survivor and can derive its safety shell only by the authorized one-time frozen CXR2 copy.
